name: notchmeter
description: Lets Claude check this Mac's AI usage limits (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity / Gemini CLI, Copilot), cost estimate and Notchmeter's advice before long work. Needs the Notchmeter app or its notchmeter command. It reads the app's cache; only when the app isn't running (or on --force) does it use the logins your AI tools saved on this Mac for one read-only request to each tool's own usage endpoint, never inference. Claude Code cost is priced from local transcripts' usage lines. No telemetry.
author: Amir Hackett
